timing_scopes.ready: native avatar_action + native cache refresh + render + SDL presentation + diagnostic instrumentation

instrumentation_note: Primary native/extract/render/present boundaries are retained. C/D additionally collect thread/process CPU time, sprite readbacks and staging counts; their overhead remains in frame/rotation times and is not subtracted. Missing old fields mean unavailable. Controls were measured earlier in the stated order.
interpretation: The retained frame-upload object remains stable across all warm records, with zero warm static uploads, but source7fd still has material warm-rotation regressions in street, dense city, forest, multi-level and smoke fixtures. Faster first-frame medians do not qualify this candidate. Original A is the nearby R6 repeat; B retains the earlier R1 PSX/original-hash run. C and D were run consecutively with one new Host and the same four-stream hash change. Their additional CPU/readback/staging diagnostics remain included in timing. All failed R1/R2/R5/R6 evidence is preserved. A subsequent neutral-texture lifetime fix is separate and is not measured by this report.
